user.title: Choose Login Mode
user.description:
Choose how to log in:
- **Main account mode**: use the car owner's Xiaomi account, requires the Device ID from the Xiaomi Car app (obtained via traffic capture, see README tutorial)
- **Shared account mode**: use a Xiaomi account that the owner has shared the car with; the Device ID is generated automatically, no capture needed

master.title: Main Account Mode
master.description: Enter your Xiaomi car account (phone number), password, and the Device ID from the Xiaomi Car app on your phone. An SMS verification code will be sent.

shared.title: Shared Account Mode
shared.description: Enter the Xiaomi account (phone number) that the owner shared the car with, and its password. The Device ID will be generated automatically (no capture needed). An SMS verification code will be sent.

code.title: SMS Verification Code
code.description: A verification code has been sent to {username}, enter it below:

car.title: Select a Car to Add
car.description: {count} car(s) are available under this account (your own cars and shared cars). Select the car to add to Home Assistant. To add more cars, run "Add Integration" again and choose another car.

data_description.deviceId: The Device ID (deviceId) of the Xiaomi Car app on your phone — it must match the app exactly. How to find it: capture traffic (e.g. ProxyPin) while using the app, then look for the mobileId or deviceId value in the request cookie/body. See README for details. Not needed in shared account mode (auto-generated).

error.invalid_device_id: Invalid Device ID: it must match the Xiaomi Car app on your phone (letters/digits/-/_ characters, e.g. YSFTVmttfxS0t_G-). See README for how to find it.

abort.already_configured: Car {car} is already configured. Choose another car to add it.
